subject: general
question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

13, 17, 19, 23, 29, ?
solution:
Given: 13, 17, 19, 23, 29, ?

**Logic: Note that this is the prime number series given from 13 onward.** 

All the given number in the series are prime numbers. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39602bfd48805b376cf628feac11e51e5874486f8ffc937255ee8fca02e9d78d.png] 

Therefore, the next prime number in this series is 31. 

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 4**".
